inspection.scope: Representation taxonomy and scalar R2/Rtilde2 model definitions. Vector/UV-completion examples require additional source-specific completion work. Targeted SU5 GG, extra5/two10 and15 completion definitions re-read; source tensor orientations converted explicitly.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

locator.anchor: List of scalar and vector LQs

claims.value: Exact SM representations are tabulated, with scalar/vector spin and conjugation conventions; a vector LQ tuple is not itself a complete UV gauge theory.
R2 is a scalar (3,2,7/6) coupling to SM fermions; one complex multiplet in the displayed single-LQ description.
Rtilde2 is scalar (3,2,1/6); source explicitly assumes three nu_R. Convert these singlet RH Weyl fields to LH conjugates.

locator.section_equations: Section2.1 pp19-22, Table2 and explicit scalar contractions

claims.value: SU5 GG: three LH10+bar5 families, scalar5+24; light-LQ completion adds one extra5 and two scalar10. Alternative adds one scalar15. Upper-index10 is [0,1,0,0], upper symmetric15 is [2,0,0,0], fundamental5 [1,0,0,0],bar5 [0,0,0,1],adj24 [1,0,0,1]. Source15 decomposes (1,3,1)+(6,1,-2/3)+(3,2,1/6); do not count its components again under a separate GSM factor.
